News 566Likes45,823ViewsFeb 152026 Hudson Williams confirmed his relationship. The ‘Heated Rivalry’ actor shared a sweet Valentine’s Day tribute on Feb. 14, posting a photo collage to his Instagram Stories featuring his longtime girlfriend. While Hudson chose to keep her identity private, the images included cozy mirror selfies of the couple together as well as a playful snapshot of her lying on top of him. Alongside a red heart emoji, Hudson simply wrote, “Happy Valentine’s Day,” but he also offered a touching detail about their relationship, revealing that she has been by his side since his “2000 gold Mazda Protégé smoked and squealed” and back when he “had no job.” The post also included a lighthearted nod to Hudson’s ‘Heated Rivalry’ costar Connor Storrie, with one image showing Hudson’s girlfriend seated beside Connor at a restaurant, complete with a red heart doodled around Connor’s face.
